capabilities: Chat with vault notes, files, and images using hosted AI or on-machine Claude Code and Codex agents
Transcribe audio recordings, imported files, and YouTube links into Markdown transcripts and summaries
Find semantically similar notes using a hosted embedding index
Generate images and videos from chats and save them to vault folders
Build and run text, media, and vault workflows in Studio from chat
extras: Freemium: free install with 500 one-time starter credits, then $9/month or $90/year for hosted AI. Version 6 removed support for user-supplied API keys, custom endpoints, and local models, and deletes previously saved provider keys on update. The plugin is MIT-licensed but the hosted service and iPhone app are not.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI chat, audio transcription, or semantic similar-note search, and connecting desktop AI coding agents to vault files requires manual setup.

relations.evidence: Use on-machine Claude Code for desktop chats and Studio text generation with its own login, permissions, and session history.
Use on-machine Codex for desktop chats and Studio tasks with its native permissions and history.

requires.name: Claude Code or Codex installed and signed in (desktop)
SystemSculpt Monthly or Yearly plan for hosted AI beyond starter credits

summary: AI chat assistant that works on your vault through hosted AI or your local Claude Code and Codex agents, with audio transcription, similar notes, and Studio workflows.
